issue.title: Create new Mission
issue.body:
Hello all. I have a question. I create and fly mission successfully. Now I want to create new mission after finish old mission or land, How? I try callback upload_mission_async() function, but it error.
And how do device stop mission? It only have start_mission_async() and pause_mission_async() function.
Thanks very much.
